'''League of Legends Championship Pacific 2025 Season Finals''' is the third Pacific League of Legends split under the LCP banner, with eight Pacific teams compete for the LCP title.

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
**Teams are split into 2 groups based on their [[LCP/2025/Mid Season/Regular Season|Mid Season's Regular Season]] performance:
***Top 4 teams are placed into Contender Group
***Bottom 4 teams are placed into Breakout Group
**Single Round Robin
**Each team plays 3 matches
**Top 2 teams of Contender Group and bottom 2 teams of Breakout Group stays in their group for the Group Seeding Bracket, all remaining teams will play in Group Breaker
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
* '''Group Breaker'''
**Matchups are determined as follows:
***Contender Group 4th vs. Breakout Group 1st
***Contender Group 3rd vs. Breakout Group 2nd
**Matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
**Winners are placed into Contender Group, losers are placed into Breakout Group
* '''Group Seeding Bracket'''
**GSL Format
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
**All teams of Contender Group and Top 2 teams of Breakout Group will play the Playoffs
* '''Playoffs'''
**Double Elimination
** Upper Bracket Quarterfinals and Semifinals matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
** All remaining matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
** Top three teams qualify for [[World_Championship/2025|Worlds]].
* All matches are played under {{Abbr|Fearless Draft|No champion can be played more than once during the entire series.}} rules after receiving positive feedback on this format during Split 1.
* '''Relegation Rules'''
**A maximum of 2 Guest teams will have to play in [[LCP/2026/Promotion|LCP 2026 Promotion]]:
*** Any Guest teams qualify for [[World_Championship/2025|Worlds]] will be exempted from the Promotion.
*** The lowest placed Guest team, regardless of their home region, will be selected to contest for the Free-for-All (FFA) Guest spot.
*** After FFA, the second Guest team selected to participate in the Promotion for the Regional Merit spot will be based on the following priority:
**** If the remaining Guest teams consist of more than one Guest team from the same home region (e.g. VCS with Secret Whales and Vikings Esports for the 2025 season), the lower placed Guest team from that home region will compete in the Promotion.
**** If the remaining Guest teams are from different home regions, the second-lowest placed Guest team in LCP, regardless of home region, will enter the Promotion.
**** Team(s) from the domestic league competing for the Regional Merit slot will not be contesting for the FFA slot.
